name: misc-macos-latest-3.10
description: A small benchmark of miscellaneous macOS-related tasks targeting model performance on generating and explaining system commands, debugging macOS issues, and producing short scripting snippets for macOS environments. Items include instruction-following prompts, command-generation tasks, and short code/shell snippets representative of macOS workflows. It is intended to assess practical utility for developer and sysadmin-style assistants rather than deep language understanding.
reputation: A niche, low-visibility dataset hosted by Optimum/Hugging Face and primarily used for internal or small-scale benchmarking of system/code-oriented assistants.
